title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer hysteresis and fix regional failover ordering
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Hotfix: tightened hysteresis windows for SLO enforcer and fixed regional failover ordering to prevent race during rapid capacity changes; mitigates customer outages during thundering herd.
description: Motivation: recent incidents showed the SLO enforcer's hysteresis window was too permissive during rapid capacity churn which led to premature regional failovers and cascading load-shedding. This PR tightens hysteresis, makes ordering of regional failover deterministic under concurrent signals, and adds safety checks to avoid double-issuing load-shed decisions. Changes address ENG-4932 and SRE-220 and are a targeted hotfix for SUP-7842. Summary of changes: 1) reduce default hysteresis from 30s->12s with config knob; 2) add compare-and-set ordering to regional failover decision path to prevent races; 3) add dedupe of concurrent load-shed signals per-request-id; 4) add unit and integration tests and an end-to-end canary in staging. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests updated - [x] Integration test for failover ordering - [x] Run canary traffic in staging for 6 hours - [x] Monitoring dashboards updated and alert thresholds adjusted - [x] Docs/CONFIG.md updated with new hysteresis knob Rollout plan: merge to main, deploy to staging, monitor canary for 6h, then rollout to 10% of capacity in prod with 30m observation window, then ramp to 100% if stable. Related links: Linear ENG-4932, incident runbook: https://linear.app/redwood/incident/ENG-4932, monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/workspace/slo-enforcer.
